Partner credentials

Password resets and new credentials

Reset a forgotten password

Enter the username on your partner credentials. A reset link goes to the work email on your partner record.

Requesting credentials

Credentials are issued only to companies with an accepted registration for the current season. Submit Form PR-2; once the records office accepts it, credentials are emailed to the registered work address within three business days.

If three business days have passed, call the records office at (847) 555-0137 with your registration confirmation code.
